facts.text: West Bloomfield was founded in 1833 when Bloomfield Township split, creating the western portion that is today West Bloomfield.
The Greater West Bloomfield Historical Society preserves local history and hosts free exhibits on the 2nd Sundays and 3rd Fridays.
Orchard Lake Road, running north–south through the township, is the main artery lined with strip malls and shopping complexes.
Cass Lake, the largest lake in Oakland County, lies partially in West Bloomfield, while Pine Lake and Orchard Lake are nearby lakes within the township.
West Bloomfield High School and the Frankel Jewish Academy of Metropolitan Detroit are located in the township, serving its youth.
In 1999, West Bloomfield Public Library partnered with Awaji City Library in Japan as sister institutions, fostering international ties.
